# Creator permission: Modern Interiors tileset (LimeZu)

This repository vendors LimeZu's "Modern Interiors" tileset and character
sprites under `meta/service/frontend/vendor/modern-interiors/`
(`character-pieces/` and `room/`). Their commercial-use terms are in the
`LICENSE.txt` in that directory: redistribution and modification, commercial
and non-commercial, royalty-free, but no resale of the assets as standalone
assets (see https://limezu.itch.io/moderninteriors).

Beyond that license, LimeZu has given permission to use these assets in
open-source projects, as comment replies on
https://limezu.itch.io/moderninteriors. The condition he attaches is that only
the parts actually used or modified may be redistributed, never the whole pack.
Those comments are informal and either party can delete them, so the exchanges
are quoted verbatim below as a version-controlled record.

## Recorded comments

**On including the assets in an open-source-licensed game** (LimeZu's reply,
2021-02-22, https://itch.io/post/2675959):

> **Marquis Kurt:** Hey! This looks like a wonderful asset pack and a much
> better tile map that what I would come up with myself. I'm considering
> purchasing this tileset in addition to the office extension, but I have a
> couple of questions regarding the paid licensing. Would this license allow me
> to include this asset in a game that were licensed under the Mozilla Public
> License or other open-source licenses? Additionally, would I be able to use
> the characters and create costumes for them on top? Thanks in advance.
>
> **LimeZu:** Hi Marquis, I'm happy you are considering to choose my assets!
> Yes, as long as people can't download the whole asset but only the parts you
> have used/modified
> Sure, you are allowed to!

**On shipping edited assets in a public GitHub repository** (LimeZu's reply,
2022-01-28, https://itch.io/post/5263868):

> **Mounir Tohami:** I am editing this asset to start implementing it inside an
> open-source game using Godot Engine, the problem is that the edited version
> will be publicly available on github, only the edited version of the sprites
> will be available in the project, i will credit you in the project page and
> will include the same license in each folder containing the sprites, no one
> will have access to the main full pack because i will not include the original
> art, sadly the license don't mention if we can use it in open-source projects
> or not, it will be great if you mentioned it if we can/can't use this asset in
> open-source projects, thank you!
>
> **LimeZu:** Sorry for the late reply Mounir! Sure, go ahead with your project
> and good luck!
